title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery files for review and approval of the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a Firm Transportation Agreement with Fairmont Copley Plaza.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the Agrement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Judith F. Judson and Brian Paul Golden. (DTE 05-GC-16)
